name: Memories.ai
description:
Memories.ai gives Claude long-term visual memory. Connect your memories.ai account and Claude can search, recall, and reason over your own indexed video library — by what's seen (visual scenes), said (transcripts), or described (captions), not just by filename.

With Memories.ai, Claude can:
• Index any public video URL into your private library and poll until it's searchable.
• Semantically search your library across clip, audio, image, and caption modalities — or run exact-text search over transcripts.
• Pull scene-by-scene visual captions and full spoken-word transcripts for any indexed video.
• Search the live public web (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X) in real time, or scrape one social video's metadata or transcript by URL.
• Ask a vision-language model free-form questions about any video or image URL, and transcribe audio to timestamped text.
• Manage the library — list videos, check indexing status, and delete videos.

You bring your own memories.ai account: connect once via OAuth and every request runs against your data with your credentials. The connector forwards your key per request and stores nothing itself. Ideal for creators, researchers, and teams turning a growing video archive into searchable, question-answerable memory.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Memories.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Memories.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.memories.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Memories.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memories.ai lists 16 MCP tools, including analyze_image, analyze_video, delete_videos, get_audio_transcription, get_video_caption, get_video_metadata, list_unique_ids, list_videos, scrape_social_video, search_audio_transcripts, search_public_videos, and search_videos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Memories.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Memories.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Memories.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Memories.ai is developed by Memories.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
